Vendored screensaver remakes. Each subdirectory keeps its upstream MIT
LICENSE. Three.js is loaded from cdnjs at the revision each remake shipped
against. maze.js is vendored from WebGLMaze@385d329 with the 250-step
solver alert removed. Flying Windows uses a gag four-pane window mark instead of a
trademarked logo. Maze wall/floor/ceiling maps are procedural canvases,
not the upstream JPEGs. maze-backrooms/ is Wolf-style 2.5D: wallpaper pillars, wet floor/missing ceiling tile swaps, one EXIT wall. No mesh props.
